scope: Trump International Hotel and Tower, Chicago (detailed schematic)
title: Trump International Hotel and Tower
blurb: Chicago’s 1,389 ft condo-hotel tower by Adrian Smith of SOM, completed in 2009. Three setbacks step the concrete frame back at the heights of the Wrigley Building, Marina City and the IBM Building, rising to a 226 ft spire above a glass, stainless steel and aluminum facade.

sourceUrls.label: Wikipedia: Trump International Hotel and Tower (Chicago)
New Civil Engineer: Windy City Wonder
NPR Illinois: Trump Stands Firm On Giant Chicago Sign

systems.name: Retail podium
systems.description: The retail, lobby and parking base along the river: lobbies, retail and the garage on floors 3 to 12. Plan and heights are schematic.

systems.name: First setback tier
systems.description: The lowest tier, rising to the first setback at 130 m on the east side, the height of the neighbouring Wrigley Building.

systems.name: Second setback tier
systems.description: The middle tier, stepping back on the west side at 179 m, the height of the Marina City towers.

systems.name: Third setback tier
systems.description: The upper tier, stepping back on the east side at 212 m, the height of 330 North Wabash (IBM Plaza).

systems.name: Spire and crown
systems.description: The top tier from 212 m to the 1,171 ft roof, with the mechanical penthouse and the 226 ft spire reaching the 1,389 ft tip.

systems.name: Facade
systems.description: The Permasteelisa curtain wall: clear low-e glass, polished stainless steel mullions, brushed stainless spandrels and clear anodized aluminum. Panel rhythm is schematic.

systems.name: Hotel floors
systems.description: The 339-room hotel on floors 17 to 27, with the Sixteen restaurant on the 16th floor. Layout is schematic.

systems.name: Residential floors
systems.description: The 486 condominiums on floors 28 to 85, the 14th floor health club and spa, and the penthouses on floors 86 to 89. Layout is schematic.

systems.name: Concrete core and structure
systems.description: The reinforced concrete core, outrigger levels at the setbacks, shear walls and caisson foundations. All sizes are schematic.

systems.name: Riverwalk and plaza
systems.description: The Chicago River, the 500 ft riverwalk, the 1.2-acre riverfront park, the plaza and Wabash Avenue. Layout is schematic.
